basic_details.job_title: SHA Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 2 Manager Operations, Medical Management and Quality Manager Posts
basic_details.short_information: State Health Agency, U.T. Chandigarh is filling 2 posts on contract: one Manager Operations and one Medical Management and Quality Manager. Applications go in an envelope to the O/o State Health Agency, Room No. 29, Second Floor, Old Sarai Building, GMSH-16, Chandigarh, and must be received by 11 November 2026 up to 4:30 PM. The pay is a consolidated Rs. 60,000/- and Rs. 55,930/- per month, and the age limit for both posts is up to 62 years.

content_sections.heading: About SHA Chandigarh
content_sections.text: State Health Agency, U.T. Chandigarh works under the Health Department of the Chandigarh Administration and functions from the Old Sarai Building, GMSH-16, Chandigarh. The notice is issued by its Chief Executive Officer and carries the logos of the National Health Authority and Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY. Both posts are attached to the office of the State Health Agency, and the Manager Operations post asks for experience in Govt. funded health insurance schemes.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications are to be submitted in an envelope, or sealed, to this address: O/o State Health Agency, Room No. 29, Second Floor, Old Sarai Building, GMSH-16, Chandigarh. Fill in your Bio-data on the Application Format, which the notice says is available on the website. Attach a self-attested photograph. Attach photocopies of your certificates/testimonials from matriculation onwards and the desired experience certificate. Add one recent attested passport size photograph. Put everything in an envelope and send or deliver it to the address above so that it is received by 11.11.2026 up to 4:30 PM. The notice does not mention whether the application should go by post, speed post or by hand, or what should be written on the envelope. Incomplete applications and applications received after the due date will not be entertained.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The age limit for both posts (Sr. No. 1 to 2) is up to 62 years. The notice does not print a cut-off date for age or any age relaxation. Qualification as printed: "Post Graduate/MBA with computer knowledge/retired. Govt. Official (group A/B)." Experience: Minimum 10 (Ten) years' experience in Govt. funded health insurance schemes. Age limit: Up to 62 years. Pay: Rs. 60,000/- per month, consolidated. Qualification: MBBS/MBBS post graduate Degree/Diploma. Experience: Minimum 2 (Two) years working experience in medical field. Age limit: Up to 62 years. Pay: Rs. 55,930/- per month, consolidated. Both posts are to be filled on a contract basis, initially for a one-year period. The contract is extendable depending upon performance and work and conduct etc. or the duration of the project. Candidates should check the official notification for the exact eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Bio-data on the Application Format Self-attested photograph Photocopies of certificates/testimonials (from matriculation onwards) Desired experience certificate One recent attested passport size photograph The notice also says applications are invited along with all educational and other required documents.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is through an interview. A list of eligible candidates for interview for both posts (Sr. No. 1 to 2) will be displayed on the official website, https://chandigarh.gov.in/ . No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. The notice does not give the interview date.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in SHA Chandigarh Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: 1 Manager Operations and 1 Medical Management and Quality Manager.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date for SHA Chandigarh Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be received by 11.11.2026 up to 4:30 PM; applications received after the due date will not be entertained.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the Manager Operations post?
faq.answer: The notice prints "Post Graduate/MBA with computer knowledge/retired. Govt. Official (group A/B)" with minimum 10 (Ten) years' experience in Govt. funded health insurance schemes.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for the Medical Management and Quality Manager post?
faq.answer: The qualification is MBBS/MBBS post graduate Degree/Diploma with minimum 2 (Two) years working experience in medical field.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit for both posts is up to 62 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary?
faq.answer: Manager Operations gets Rs. 60,000/- per month and Medical Management and Quality Manager gets Rs. 55,930/- per month, both as a consolidated amount.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Send your Bio-data on the Application Format with a self-attested photograph, photocopies of certificates from matriculation onwards, the experience certificate and one attested passport size photograph in an envelope to O/o State Health Agency, Room No. 29, Second Floor, Old Sarai Building, GMSH-16, Chandigarh.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Selection is by interview; the list of eligible candidates for interview will be displayed on https://chandigarh.gov.in/.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, both posts are on contract basis, initially for one year, extendable depending upon performance and work and conduct etc. or the duration of the project.

faq.question: Q10. Can retired government officials apply for Manager Operations?
faq.answer: The qualification column for Manager Operations mentions "retired. Govt. Official (group A/B)" along with minimum 10 years' experience in Govt. funded health insurance schemes, and the pay listed for the post is Rs. 60,000/- per month consolidated.
